recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit. Revisit only if a current build-scope profile detail page is shown to drop ElementDefinition.comment again; that would likely require investigation in the current publisher/rendering toolchain rather than edits to retired DSTU-era Java generator code.
issue_request: FHIR-8596 was a Published/Persuasive non-substantive FHIR-I correction raised for DSTU1. It reported that profile element comments were not displayed in generated element-detail pages, using an old USLab DiagnosticReport profile definitions page as the example, and the Jira application comment recorded SVN revision 6609.
initial_application: The issue was applied in Git commit 43b01e970731b08726424b8872a93730552760a8, '#8596 - fix comments falling out of profiles,' whose git-svn metadata points to build@6609. The semantic hunk changed the old Java ProfileGenerator so it copied comments when e.getComments() was not empty.
additional_context: The old Java ProfileGenerator/ProfileUtilities paths changed by the application commit are absent from the current checkout; ProfileGenerator was deleted in the 2021 build/tooling refactor. Current fhir.ini still has active profile entries, the profile definitions template delegates rendering to generated definitions content, current profiling guidance names ElementDefinition.comment as a profile documentation mechanism, and current CI generated ElementDefinition detail output shows a Comments row for ElementDefinition.comment.
reconciliation: No source files were changed. The original renderer bug was already applied, no current FHIR-core source hunk remains to reapply, and the current generated detail surface demonstrates that comments are displayed.
